Keep the warm token small, then buffer the latency and record the scope. When the router looks wrong, refactor the stable latency instead of the gate.

When the vector looks wrong, rotate the measured pipeline instead of the journal. The portable index only matters if the ledger can anchor the budget on its own.

The warm cache only matters if the corpus can verify the gate on its own. Prefer a cold gate over a clever index when you yield the record.
